notes.title: 2.8.0 Final Playtest Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello![/p][p]First of all, I want to thank everyone who has taken the time to join us on this journey. This will be the last update for the playtest, however, the demo will return to the page as soon as this event ends, including all the updates we’ve made over the past months.[/p][p]In the meantime, here’s what’s new:[/p][p]
[/p][h1]New Story Points[/h1][p]The story at the beginning of the game has been rewritten, as well as several dialogues to maintain consistency.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/94248d6869fa5e91bf4f42fc89c3b270105a51af.png"][/img][/p][p]A new motive has been added for climbing the mountain: to collect the selenite shards and help the moon defeat the serpent.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/4e8d099d6653b94a317c4aff2d2d5bfb79092e8f.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Start Screen[/h1][p]When creating a new game, or starting the game for the very first time, a new start screen will appear.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/67983ec1e570abc867a18324f51290d6c30ccccc.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h2]Run End Indicators[/h2][p]Now, each time a run ends, a message will appear showing the reason for it. The reasons a run can end are the following:[/p][list][*][p]Running out of health[/p][/*][*][p]Running out of health due to starvation damage[/p][/*][*][p]The night ends[/p][/*][*][p]Completing the Dungeon[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/d26ca6d5d45982dddb8d4b862119a83be1716584.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/92c92b37e38249b40982a1a8b6bd716003cd4621.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/06fccd80c053d609d602713451b29a39bdf520c5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/474f060fecab0af28d9a79e4daa3ad7ed8a5e2ec.png"][/img][/carousel][p]
[/p][h1]Status Indicators[/h1][p]A new status indicator has been added, alongside the health and appetite indicators.[/p][list][*][p]Health – Poisoned[/p][/*][*][p]Appetite – Starving or Hungry[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/0ddeead15c09385050496f9e8dcf0bd1ee1dfb18.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/eeb732c721ce2d2548270401f97020896ec54514.png"][/img][/carousel][p]
[/p][h1]Various Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Corrected spelling mistakes in several localized texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the hunger indicator to appetite. Now, instead of decreasing, the bar increases.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the wording of stats descriptions to make them clearer.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new font for reading texts to improve legibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new rules for Moon Dashers generation to avoid impossible dashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how Moon Whispers are displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where berries could be seen inside bushes or burrows but were not interactable.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the obtainable items during the tutorial and expanded the text areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Moon Whisper that triggers when the night is about to end.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue when initializing the Steam connection that prevented achievements from appearing. Achievements can now be unlocked in the final version.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a visual indicator when performing an invalid action.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]-Hector[/p]

notes.title: 2.7.0 Environment Update
notes.content:
[p]It’s been more than a full moon since the last time I wrote. Which makes calling it a weekly update a bit contradictory. [/p][p]We got really excited about this version, so it took us a little longer to bring it to you, but I’m thrilled for you to see everything we’ve been working on![/p][p]
[/p][h1]New Environment![/h1][p]Each dungeon has its own theme, color, and environment. However, the second-to-last dungeon had remained more like a combination of the four previous ones. We finally managed to give it its own unique voice.[/p][p]
[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/555fd6b910776f2ad5648592c611c81b809506c6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/5a7ac1fba3a7a876a35843352a148de4497cdc6a.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h1]Dungeon Environment Updates[/h1][p]Not only has the fifth dungeon been reworked. We’ve also reworked all the other dungeons, adding elevation and new effects like fog.[/p][p]
[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/6dbdab554f56f137b360baa760d1d1f8f3b9053e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/a50a70173c8cd901fbfcd489a8c4cc89efc07d2f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/061f93f1fdfcd4bd07cf00195321fb7e94ee8635.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/54bb7c0e04c0a38c96e27c5a2dc075ab2b6d908a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/f374d7df8e6c3029d34880e7e40f80e66b549ee6.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h1]Dash Implementation[/h1][p]Previously, dash was only available in the tutorial. Now, it’s part of the natural dungeon generation and can be used in regular runs.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/cb4e36d7612e90617639155ff38d1a4caa7e3c33.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Creature Variations[/h1][p]Every creature now comes with different color palettes and slight variations. These palettes also have rarity levels, so expect to run into some surprises![/p][p] [/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/0e6cbec15c7ab258cc5f5c6bf17d454d94dff77c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/98ab3d1f1e9a0bf7debaa6db5ca87df5f4b961fe.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/55dad03d59b1e8492bc0db2d834f3acb462fc992.png"][/img][/carousel][h1]
Damage Effects[/h1][p]Now, whenever characters take damage, you’ll see a small effect outlining their silhouette in a flat color. This helps with overall visibility during gameplay.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/a750f69e6d97fa6b189c84ee051cd17c884b12c8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Hunger Update[/h1][p]There are now two different ways to experience hunger: the classic one where it constantly decreases (now called *starving*), and a new one where hunger decreases only when performing actions. Be careful, some actions will consume more hunger than others![/p][h1][/h1][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][olist][*][p]In corridor generation, the closest path is now chosen, preventing hallways from cutting through rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed infinite dash in the same spot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the possibility of dashing through walls.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][/p][p]-Hector[/p][p]  [/p]

notes.title: 2.6.0 - Narrative update
notes.content: [h1]Hello everyone![/h1][p]This week, we've focused on giving a twist to the story, the Moon character, and her relationship with Omi.[/p][p]The most noticeable change is that the character "the light behind the tree", who used to comment on the tutorials, has been replaced by the Moon herself. From now on, the Moon will be the one guiding us through our entire adventure.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/916791c5d3ea169e56e53fcd243f7a8d54a042bd.png"][/img][/p][p]Also, at the beginning of each night, there's a chance the Moon will share more information about the world.[/p][p]We've added a counter to keep track of how many nights have passed since the beginning of our adventure.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/cc71786b0fb61b0e2b073786fddde0109d130783.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/2b48a0a09b5db3e1bd5afb65b24777a16341a5a9.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]Other changes[/p][list][*][p]Language can now be set from the Steam settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Redesign of the language selection, info, and data analysis screens.[/p][/*][*][p]If it's the first time launching the game, a new game will automatically start.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug in the second tutorial where fruits were picked up instead of eaten.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug that prevented picking up objects in the third tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the button prompt for changing chomp style in the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed misplaced tiles in tutorial 1 and in the dungeon entrance screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization corrections.[/p][/*][/list][p]-Hector[/p]

notes.title: 2.5.0 update - Third Tutorial Dungeon Rework
notes.content: [p]This week, we’ve been reworking the [b]third floor[/b] of the [b]tutorial dungeon[/b]. The goal of this floor is to introduce players to Omi’s core abilities—his [b]chomp[/b] and his [b]howl[/b], which reveals hidden elements in the environment.[/p][p]To better showcase these mechanics, we’ve designed a new maze-like layout that encourages exploration. You’ll need to use your abilities to [b]find the correct path[/b]… and who knows, you might stumble upon a hidden treasure or two along the way.[/p][p]We’re excited to share some screenshots of the updated floor—hope you enjoy the new look![/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/e346ddc0de7e59053b2661e0da3979df38219bea.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/d99b537d21a2767208adf04d8642252a87a8adf1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/4f9373fe028bb2eb73b2707ac7a5399e57db29a7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/66bcb1de170c52a6d3c6aea3ebc5fe0f3393b9ec.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/184d23c6598eadf7e4e1722b6366553914055365.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/0336e9040777655cb95b224a5e84fea48811b9c5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/5f0e80fcd66e60d3d8c125758d56b986b0095216.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]-Hector[/p]

notes.title: 2.4.0 First Button Prompt Update
notes.content: [h1]Hi everyone,[/h1][p]This week, we’ve been working on improving how button prompts behave in [b][i]Onychomp[/i][/b]. In earlier versions, each interactable object had its own area trigger. Whenever Omi entered that space, the corresponding prompt would appear. While this worked in principle, it often led to clutter—especially in areas where many objects were close together. Prompts could flood the screen, and sometimes even cover up important gameplay moments, like chomping enemies.[/p][p]To address this, and as a step toward a larger visual update for prompts, we’ve implemented a [b]unified system[/b] that gives us much better control over how and when prompts appear.[/p][p]From now on, we can limit the number of prompts visible at any given time. The system will prioritize prompts based on Omi’s position, ensuring that only nearby and relevant interactions are shown. As space frees up on screen, the next closest prompt will be allowed to appear. This helps reduce noise while keeping the gameplay experience smooth and readable.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/40ecd8a54c0e78a6d6b847082b21892acdb0a839.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/543010bd48e8a4902b64074383ffa581493b4beb.png"][/img][/carousel][p]We’ve also added a priority system. Some prompts, like those used to change chomp styles or interact with staircases, now take precedence. While these are active, other prompts are hidden to keep the player’s focus clear. Additionally, prompts are now hidden during certain actions—like when Omi is performing a chomp—and automatically reappear once the action ends.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/46e617431e0603846823eec8deece57787f703dc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/3977d48d03500198aadbb6f633205bac81be0f6a.png"][/img][/carousel][h3]Alongside these changes, we’ve made a few tweaks:[/h3][list][*][p]Increased the number of creatures in the Flower Path and Rocky Mountain dungeons[/p][/*][*][p]Added more items across both areas[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the speed of rats[/p][/*][*][p]Added animations to button prompts for a more polished feel[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the font size on prompts for better readability[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your continued support. We’re excited to keep polishing the experience and can’t wait to share more soon.[/p][p]— Héctor[/p]

notes.title: 2.3.0 Tutorial Dungeon Update and Dash Mecanic
notes.content: [p][b]So good to see you again![/b][/p][p]First of all, we want to sincerely apologize for the delay in updates — we’ve been hard at work on some exciting changes we hope you’ll love![/p][p]We’d love to hear from you on our [url="https://discord.gg/wjCZ7SrNzu" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h1]New Mechanic: Lunar Dash![/h1][p]In certain corridors, you’ll now find a crescent-shaped selenite tile at the entrance. Press the spacebar or middle mouse button to launch yourself forward — and if you time it right, you can chain these dashes all the way to the end of the path! You might even smash through selenite formations along the way.[/p][p]This feature is still a work in progress, and we’d love to hear your thoughts to help us polish it further. For now, you’ll find it in the first two floors of the tutorial area — we’re actively working on bringing it to the rest of the dungeons in an upcoming update.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/17d776097803a105b45a68c7027907e72324d947.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/555c345fa867d6ddc25fe4f5be32e40d8b26520d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/cb0892750f54254fedfab29bd2458ed9f9b0b4fd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/ac1f9b313bd0dc77b04192d217ae7cda7f5f5182.png"][/img][/carousel][h1]Environmental Redesign [/h1][p]We’ve been improving the atmosphere of certain levels by adding new visual elements like fog, cliffs, and elevation changes. These updates are currently being tested on the first two floors of the tutorial, with plans to roll them out to the rest of the game soon.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/93254524de60a61bd1e100d546742511c4aa7e78.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/c5e1eb464250a73c5221effb5a1400ee0ec4479f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/6b4a33207e24ddbc5698e2faf1dd52566aab86ad.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/fb4abf8bf977f8c1883fcde5fee394e5f4c4e86f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588784/d5af78d9781652aa563e76703e9a0b45693c87c6.png"][/img][/carousel][h1]Additional Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]New VFX when stepping into puddles[/p][/*][*][p]New SFX when walking[/p][/*][*][p]Object outlines in dungeons to improve visibility[/p][/*][/list][h1]Fixes & Tweaks[/h1][list][*][p]Grammar and text polish for English localization[/p][/*][*][p]VFX rework for the Captain’s entrance[/p][/*][*][p]Music mix adjustments for better audio clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Button prompt text design updated for improved readability[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks so much for your patience and continued support. We can't wait to hear what you think! [/p][p]-Hector[/p]

notes.title: 2.2.0 Update
notes.content:
[b]Thanks everyone for all the support during this first week![/b]
We’re continuing to work hard on all aspects of the game to keep improving the experience.
Here’s everything included in this update:

[h2]Added[/h2]

[list]
[*] Analytics Feature
[/list]
This feature allows us to track your progress during the beta test to better understand where we can improve the experience. It only collects in-game events, so we can tweak and correct issues.
[b]You can disable this option[/b] if you prefer — before reaching the title screen, you'll be asked to accept or deny data collection for each session.

[h2]Content Adjustments[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased Omi’s movement speed.
[*] Increased and differentiated creature speeds.
[/list]
Now, rats are the fastest, followed by: Worms → Rabbits → Snakes → Hedgehogs.
[list]
[*] Rock Mountain Dungeon adjustments:
[/list]
-Night time duration increased to 180 seconds.
-One additional creature will now spawn on each floor.
[list]
[*] Removed dirt lens effect from the camera.
[*] Removed camera shake effect when starving.
[*] Removed echo visual effect when taking damage.
[*] Lowered the overall volume of UI sound effects.
[*] Increased probablity of the music inside dungeons.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed translation issues in the second tutorial (second burrow).
[*] Fixed translation issues on the advice screen's first text.
[*] Fixed black screen when selecting "New Game."
[*] Fixed creatures passing through walls.
[*] Fixed creatures and corpses not aligning correctly with the grid.
[*] Fixed creatures floating over water pools.
[*] Fixed rat attack AI missing its target.
[*]Fixed poison status causing a looping sound effect.
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to Playtest Patch
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all for registering for the Playtest![/b]

As mentioned, we want to stay in touch with all of you. We plan to communicate every week or two with updates based on your suggestions, as well as general fixes and improvements.

This update includes:

[list]
[*] Common menu UI added to the dungeons
[*] Load indicator animation
[*] Universal version save data
[/list]

Fixes:

[list]
[*] Volume settings now work properly
[*] Fixed double scene change calls
[*] "Join Discord" button link corrected
[*] Eat animation adjusted
[*] Translations added
[*] Lost selection in menus fixed
[*] Event percentages corrected
[*] Third Continue slot fixed
[/list]
